tunnel.movement_other_detail: He reported being 'hurling along the tunnel' at tremendous speed and hearing a 'loud buzzing sound, which hurt my ears.'

arrival.other_being_detail: A man ~27 wearing Levis and a white t-shirt identified himself as the experiencer's 'guide'; other men (including another who introduced the life review) and later 'two men' identifying as 'guardian angels.'

environment.environment_other_detail: White mist/daylight; beautiful flower gardens; grass lawns with individually beautiful blades; small waterfalls; a distant golden city with large buildings described as gold; a building 'looking much like a library.'

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: He did not remember returning through the tunnel; he said they 'traveled through the darkness of space' and then he woke up on an examination table.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Jesus told him 'to tell all people of my visit with him' and to tell people 'that he is real.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Choking on a hard-boiled egg with inability to breathe, followed by a 120-volt electrical shock at a water fountain; resuscitation described as back-pressure lifesaving/CPR and ambulance call.

person_demographics.religious_background_detail: He stated, 'At least I am a Christian' and referenced Sunday school classes.
person_demographics.occupation: United States Navy (on duty at time of event)

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: A distressing 'darkened mist' engulfing/squeezing 'hot area' prior to the tunnel; later a 'small stage' where Jesus appeared from mist after initially being only a voice.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with observation of resuscitation, then movement through walls/objects, then dark mist/engulfment, then tunnel, then arrival in white mist/daylight with voices/people, then guided tour and life review, then meeting deceased schoolmates, then encounter with Jesus, then escorted return described as traveling through darkness of space, waking in hospital.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: He described entering a 'darkened mist' that engulfed him with a squeezing/hot sensation 'as if I was inside a womb' before the tunnel; he also described the tunnel as like a dryer vent pipe with light shining in from outside and a loud buzzing that hurt his ears; return described as traveling through 'darkness of space' rather than through the tunnel.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I was near the ceiling of this room watching the sailors doing things to save my life."; "I was in spirit form and yet I still felt alive"; "Once inside I wanted out badly. This thing was engulfing me."; "Immediately I was hurling along the tunnel much faster than I wished."; "During this review which lasted about one second or less, I saw all that I had previously seen while living on earth."; "They explained to me that no one ever dies."; "Soon I saw Jesus standing in front of me."; "That was the most perfect love I have ever felt."; "Well, I have just returned from Heaven."
